name: Goblin Outpost
description: A crude wooden palisade erected by the local goblin clan. Goblins guard their stolen goods here.
visualTheme: A messy encampment of skins and wood, with spikes, campfires roasting questionable meat, and standard flags.

history.createdWhy: Built by goblin scouts as a staging ground for village raids.
history.builtWho: Constructed by the Blood-Club goblin clan.
history.majorEvents: Surprised a guard vanguard patrol, setting up local tensions.
history.whyExists: Serves as the frontline fort of Grak'Zul's forces in the foothills.
history.currentConflicts: Wood Goblins are actively raiding loggers passing the thicket connection.
